name: styles
title: Tokens & reset
description: Shared design tokens (Ref → Sys → Cmp) and CSS reset, with the default brand theme. Install once before any component — every component references only the Cmp tier defined here. tokens.css holds Cmp + the type-role classes; the Ref + Sys values come from the brand file beside it (mango), which applies with no attribute set. Add `brand-<name>` for an alternate theme.
docs: Import `src/styles/reset.css`, `src/styles/tokens.css` and the one brand sheet you use from `src/styles/themes/` at your app's entry. The Sando guide is in `docs/sando/`; start at `getting-started.md`.
